title: The first six auctions of US Treasury inflation-indexed securities (TIPS), January 1997 to April 1998
source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service, Fiscal Data, 'Treasury Securities Auctions Data' (endpoint v1/accounting/od/auctions_query)

notes: Downloaded 2026-10-14; SHA-256 of the API response 98cee2388bae1a089c76f77766811695aaceff226872bb8121fd02900ce8b690. The first auction (10-year note 9128272M3, 1997-01-29) cleared at a real yield of 3.449%; its reference CPI on the dated date 1997-01-15 is 158.43548, interpolated from the non-seasonally-adjusted CPI-U of October and November 1996 (the three-month lag): 158.3 + 14/31 x (158.6 - 158.3). The Treasury's rule for the reference CPI is checked in checks/check_ch03.py against CPIAUCNS in fred_prices_monthly.
